cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called the spare chair unnecessary, then put the cake on it. I taught you to count seats before finding somewhere for the food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake needed a flat surface.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found one without tilting the cake this time. Now the extra guest has taken the piano stool, and the pianist has nowhere to sit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Take it to the piano, then cut me a slice from the chair we didn't need. I taught you to serve the host last; today you can serve your teacher standing up.
